historical_comparison.architectural_choice: A separately authorized trusted-host capability pattern may suffice; the provider/issuer/event/time/revocation mechanism remains unresolved. Do not automatically reinstate authorization-only branches or transplant production decisions or caller trust flags.
historical_comparison.removal_limit: Phase 118 removed operator-signature prerequisites for the exact trusted-source MB2 promotion, replacing them with trusted-source validation, normal PR review and green CI. This is neither a universal ban on contextual review nor authentication of arbitrary owner-supplied claims.

provider_investigation.claim_limit: Repository-grounded investigation, not an assertion about external services or undisclosed deployment configuration. A GitHub task connector authenticates repository operations, not contextual reviewer events.

reuse_separation_matrix.non_transferable_authority: A production canonical-admission decision, serialized audit or isolated-test capability cannot authorize contextual review.
reuse_separation_matrix.trust_assumption: Externally authenticated host owns access control; no provider is implemented here.

reuse_separation_matrix.non_transferable_authority: The trusted_human_review flag and personal-assessment approval cannot authorize contextual claims; its no-fork history cannot replace conflicting-review retention.
reuse_separation_matrix.trust_assumption: Human approval is a trusted-caller assertion, not independent principal authentication.
